# ReviewBuddy

> ReviewBuddy helps Australian trade businesses get more Google reviews and shows them on their own website. Setup is done for the customer. The 7-day trial does not need a card.

## What it does

- Gives each business one review link and a QR code. The customer picks the review site, such as Google or Facebook.
- Shows reviews on the business's own website, with the rating and review count. They update when a new one comes in.
- Growth plan: an automatic review request after each job, one polite reminder, and past customers asked too.
- Free setup. When a live Stripe count is available, the site shows how many of the next 200 setups are left. If that count cannot be read, the line is hidden.

## Offer and prices

- 7-day free trial, no card needed. Add a card before day 8 to keep going.
- If there is no card by day 8, the account pauses. Review requests and syncing stop until a card is added in the app.
- Cancel any time from the billing page in the account. Access stays until the end of the billing period.
- Starter: $49 a month, AUD, GST included. You do the asking.
- Growth: $75 a month, AUD, GST included. The asking happens without you.
- Try Starter free goes to Embed My Reviews registration with plan 5. Try Growth free goes to plan 6. The trial is not stored on this website.
